class.name: cartesian_controller/CartesianVelocityControllerSim
class.description: Cartesian velocity control using a position interface. This is used in conjunction with Gazebo which, at the moment of writing this code, does not fully support a joint velocity interface.

class.name: cartesian_controller/CartesianDynamicsController
class.description: Publishes the operational-space dynamics of the arm - the task-space inertia, the centrifugal and Coriolis wrench and the gravity wrench - for a controller to use as a feedforward. Reads the joint states only, so it runs alongside whichever controller is driving the arm.
